blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Led by Olympic double gold medalist Carlos Yulo, Team Philippines competes in the women’s and men’s artistic gymnastics competition in the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026. The qualification events and the apparatus finals are scheduled from September 21 to September 25 at Rainbow Hall of Nagoya City General Gymnasium. SOURCE: Asian Games official website. Information is subject to change.
